newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CLARK RESIGNS AS NOTTINGHAM FOREST MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CLARK RESIGNS AS NOTTINGHAM FOREST MANAGER.

text.p: Nottingham Forest, rooted at the bottom of the English premier league, said on Thursday they had accepted the resignation of manager Frank Clark.
Clark, who took over from Brian Clough in May 1993, had expressed frustration at his inability to spend money on new players as protracted takeover negotiations left the club's future unclear.
Forest, relegated in the final season of Clough's otherwise highly successful 18-year reign, won promotion in Clark's first season in charge and were UEFA Cup quarter-finalists last year.
But his team has been crippled by injuries this season and his strikers have regularly failed to find the net.
Forest have not won a league game since a 3-0 victory over Coventry City on the opening day of the season, a 16-match streak which is a worst ever for the premier league.
The club said chairman Irving Korn accepted Clark's resignation at an emergency board meeting on Wednesday evening.
